conditions.evidence: histologically proven soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs) of the extremities
conditions.label: soft-tissue sarcomas of the extremities

output.population: a cohort of 51 patients with histologically proven soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs) of the extremities; patients with metastatic and/or recurrent STSs at presentation were excluded
output.summary: Pre-treatment FDG-PET/CT and MRI scans from a retrospectively evaluated cohort of patients with histologically proven soft-tissue sarcomas of the extremities, used to build a radiomics model predicting lung metastases.
